article.story: OGDEN, Utah -- — Tyler Weaver scored 21 points as Utah Valley beat Weber State 101-93 on Saturday. Weaver went 7 of 8 from the field (5 for 6 from 3-point range) for the Wolverines (2-0). Dominick Nelson shot 5 of 11 from the field and 8 for 13 from the line to add 18 points. Braden Housley shot 4 of 6 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line to finish with 15 points, while adding six assists and three steals. Mason Abittan led the Wildcats (0-2) in scoring, finishing with 22 points. Weber State also got 19 points from ArDarius Grayson. Augustine Ekwe finished with 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
